cues.speaker: forewoman
cues.text: Last freighter's plated. Good work, night shift.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: I count six shields on six freighters. What's on your tug?

cues.speaker: apprentice
cues.text: There's another mold across the cut. Clear that battery and I'll fetch it.

cues.speaker: apprentice
cues.text: Battery's out. I've got the mold. Start the pour.

cues.speaker: forewoman
cues.text: Take the old service tunnel. We'll pour at the auxiliary furnace.

cues.speaker: forewoman
cues.text: Still red at the edges. Keep that cruiser away from the tug.

cues.speaker: apprentice
cues.text: Plate's cool enough. My call. Mount it.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Transport is warm. Why isn't the ward boarding?

cues.speaker: nurse
cues.text: Warm isn't power. Not one incubator plugs into that ship.

cues.speaker: nurse
cues.text: Hold formation at the tender. We'll slide the converter across.

cues.speaker: nurse
cues.text: Green on the test plug. Bring the smallest cot first.

cues.speaker: nurse
cues.text: We missed the transfer. Switching to the greenhouse cart with its own battery.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Ward transport, can you give Astra a count?

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Leave them the channel, Tomas.

cues.speaker: nurse
cues.text: Astra, change that last line on the manifest. One more passenger.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: We could fit two more seats if we left the plants.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: Sir, those are their lungs. The reeds ride with the patients.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: Take the green reed pallet to the launch skiff. Keep the roots wet.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: Reeds aboard. Hear them? My patients can breathe.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: The skiff will collect the reeds by water. Nobody boards without them.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: Red egg ahead. The guardians are tending the marked brood. Spare the eggs; the raiders aren't ours.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: That egg is hurt. Follow the clinic boat around the outside.

cues.speaker: keeper
cues.text: All patients through. Find us a wet corner at Astra.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: Tug crew, bring the whole tow cradle. That maintenance section stays attached.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: The tug says that compartment's empty. Cut it loose. I want you home.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: It's feeding them air. Stop talking a second, Tomas. Listen.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: Take the wing light. Guide the cradle through and I'll lash the section in.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: Tow secured. Every compartment is coming with me.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: Sending out the long cable instead. Slow tow, whole ship.

cues.speaker: sister
cues.text: Blockade behind us. Aegis Four and maintenance section both in tow.

cues.speaker: director
cues.text: Three transports, three offline flight pads. This wire is the last clean copy.

cues.speaker: one
cues.text: Not one of us jumps while you're still on that cable.

cues.speaker: director
cues.text: Left, cover the pad courier. Right, stop the walker before it reaches my relay.

cues.speaker: director
cues.text: Walker down. Third copy verified. Disconnecting now.

cues.speaker: director
cues.text: Pad delivered. All three cockpits have the vectors.

cues.speaker: director
cues.text: Pulling the relay cartridge. The pilots can copy it aboard the tender.

cues.speaker: one
cues.text: One reads back: six point four. Cable aboard.

cues.speaker: two
cues.text: Two confirms: six point four. Director aboard.

cues.speaker: three
cues.text: Three confirms: six point four. Jumping together.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Foundry night shift. Greenhouse ward. Terminal families. Clinic boat. Aegis crew. All three relay transports. Every name, Tomas.
